lines.en: I drag my left foot and walk slowly.
My leather trousers are worn through; wind gets in.

lines.zh: 我沿着篱笆走，扶着木桩。
lines.en: I walk the fence line, holding the posts.
My back is bent; I cannot straighten it.
My steps are lighter than a chicken's.

lines.zh: 田里的稻草人朝我点头。
lines.en: The scarecrow in the field nods at me.
I go around the mud puddle, afraid to fall.
Wind blows through my patched hat.
I reach the door and stop again.

lines.zh: 这条院子路我走了很久。
lines.en: I have walked this yard path a long while.
The skin on my hands is split; it does not hurt.
I cough as I walk, softly.
I stand under the porch.
No lamp in the house, and no one.
I feel my pocket; it is empty.
Water drips from the eaves onto the step.

lines.zh: 我记得这扇门原先是开的。
lines.en: I remember this door used to be open.
The grass in the yard has grown tall.
I wait for someone to call me to dinner.
Sun warms my old leather coat.

lines.zh: 我想喊一声，嗓子是哑的。
lines.en: I try to call out; my voice is gone.
It has been so long I forget the time.
You stand too close to the door.
You look like my own child.
I take off my hat and show my bald head.
Those leather boots of yours are sturdy.
I squint to place you and cannot.
You smell of fresh grass.
I raise a hand as if to greet you.
You back away; I lower my head.
These old bones of mine — not frightening, are they?

lines.zh: 你手里那袋东西，是给我的？
lines.en: That bag in your hand — is it for me?
This hide of mine stops nothing.
I crouch and stay down a while.
The coat is torn; bone underneath.

lines.zh: 这一下把我帽子打飞了。
lines.en: That blow knocked my hat clean off.
I hold the door frame; my legs give.

lines.zh: 我晃了两下，才没栽进菜地。
lines.en: I sway twice and avoid the vegetable patch.

lines.zh: 我的帽子不知道滚哪去了。
lines.en: I do not know where my hat rolled.

lines.zh: 我喘不上气，虽然不用喘。
lines.en: I gasp for breath I do not need.
Stop hitting; at my age.
I shuffle to the wall step by step.
Is that soup I smell?

lines.zh: 我闻见热气了，很久没有。
lines.en: I smell something warm; it has been long.
Even hard bread would do.
You carry a bowl; I see it.

lines.zh: 我扶着门框，朝碗挪一步。
lines.en: Holding the frame, I shuffle a step toward the bowl.
Is my place still set at the table?
Just one bowl, then I will go.
My teeth are poor; it must be soaked soft.
This smells like what my wife cooked.

lines.zh: 我的手伸到一半，停在半空。
lines.en: My hand stops halfway, hanging in the air.
This frame of mine tips at one bump.
You steady me — thank you.
I hit the door frame and drop my hat.
Do not rush; my legs are slow.
We squeeze in the doorway and both laugh.

lines.zh: 我的皮衣蹭了你的袖子。
lines.en: My leather coat rubs your sleeve.
I step back and clear the way.
It was not hard; my bones are light.
I am old; I cannot out-shove you.
I hold the wall to stay upright.
She has been gone some years.

lines.zh: 她的围裙还挂在钉子上。
lines.en: Her apron still hangs on the nail.
I keep this yard alone.
Nights are cold; there is only one quilt.
I do not quite remember her voice.

lines.zh: 我们在这屋里过了半辈子。
lines.en: We spent half a life in this house.
She always said I walked too loudly.

lines.zh: 现在我自己跟自己说话。
lines.en: Now I talk to myself.
She loved sitting on those porch steps.
I am still waiting for the door to open.
I pick up a scrap of old leather.
This hide could patch a sleeve.
There is a nail on the ground; I keep it.
I bend slowly, afraid to wrench my back.
Picking things up is an old habit.
I recognize this patch.
I tuck the leather into my coat.
This is enough for two patches.
A shame to throw this hide away.

lines.zh: 我的衣服本来就是拼的。
lines.en: My clothes were patches to begin with.
Someone has come into the yard.
The door hinge creaks once.
I look up; my neck cracks.
Who is trampling my vegetable patch?
The chickens call before I hear it.
I put down the leather in my hands.
Not wind — footsteps.
I turn, holding on to the door frame.
The yard has only this one gate.
I know everyone who comes here.
You should not come at this hour.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，这次不是招呼。
lines.en: I raise my hand — not to greet this time.
I am old, but do not underestimate me.
This yard is mine to keep.

lines.zh: 院门没关，你是自己走进来的。
lines.en: The gate was open. You walked in yourself.
I close in, limping.
I raise my hand; the nails are long.
Do not run; I cannot catch you.
I block the door; you cannot get out.
Only a little strength is left in me.
Three paces; I can reach.
I hold still and let you swing first.
There is no armor under this leather.

lines.zh: 我提防你的手，不提防你的脸。
lines.en: I mind your hands, not your face.
I have saved this swing for a while.
You back to the wall — saves me the walk.

lines.zh: 我喘得像风箱，还没倒下。
lines.en: I wheeze like a bellows, but I am still up.
Do not touch anything in the house.
Just one blow; one is all I need.

lines.zh: 我扶着墙走，一步也没停。
lines.en: I walk along the wall and never stop.
Do not touch that hoe.

lines.zh: 我在门口喘气，你在里面听。
lines.en: I wheeze at the door, and you listen inside.
I raise my arm and three joints pop.
I swing a slap; it is light.
My nails scratch the back of your hand.
My strength is small; do not laugh.
That swing made even me sway.
I grab your sleeve and hold on.
One push from you and I am down.
It landed, and it is only six.
After the swing I am out of breath.
Do not hit back too hard.
I guard my chest and back away.
This slap is like shooing chickens.
My fingers are stiff and will not curl.
I lunge and cling to you.
This is all the strength old age leaves.

lines.zh: 我用肩膀撞你，自己先歪了。
lines.en: I hit you with my shoulder and stumble first.
I grab for your hair and catch air.

lines.zh: 我从门廊的阴影里出来。
lines.en: I come out of the porch's shadow.
Grass clippings still cling to my leather coat.
The chickens in the yard scatter.

lines.zh: 我记得这屋子的每一块砖。
lines.en: I know every brick of this house.
The sill is high; I lift my foot over.
Dawn is near; I ought to go back.
I have only one shoe left.
The bucket by the well is still empty.
This place used to be lively.
I stand a while before I move.
A stretch of fence is down, unrepaired.
I know which ground is soft.
I will not light that lamp indoors.
This counts as coming home.
Fire catches my coat; a burnt smell.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上摔下去，爬不起来。
lines.en: I fall off the step and cannot get up.

lines.zh: 水淹过我的头，我不挣扎。
lines.en: Water closes over my head; I do not struggle.
The blast throws me into the vegetable patch.

lines.zh: 箭射穿我的袖子，钉在门上。
lines.en: An arrow through my sleeve pins it to the door.

lines.zh: 光晃得我睁不开眼，很暖。
lines.en: The light blinds me, and it is warm.
The bowl has been empty for years.

lines.zh: 雷打在院子里，我站不住了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the yard; I cannot stand.
I fall into that darkness again.
